title: Claude Code weekly limits permanently raised 25% from September 14
summary: ClaudeDevs announced that from September 14 standard weekly limits in Claude Code would be permanently raised by 25% for Pro, Max, Team, and seat-based Enterprise plans, and that a temporary 50% increase would remain in place until then. This is a limit change, not a reset, and it is not counted in reset statistics.

ko.title: Claude Code 사후 분석 후 모든 구독자 한도 초기화
ko.summary: Claude Code의 세 가지 품질 문제에 대한 사후 분석을 게시한 뒤, ClaudeDevs는 모든 구독자의 사용 한도를 초기화했다고 발표했습니다. 게시물에는 어떤 한도 창이 초기화되었는지 명시되어 있지 않습니다. Boris Cherny도 같은 날 사후 분석 링크를 게시했습니다.

sources.excerpt: All are fixed in v2.1.116+ and we've reset usage limits for all subscribers.
sources.evidenceSummary: States a usage-limit reset for all subscribers; windows not named.
sources.verificationMethod: Reached by resolving the t.co link in Boris Cherny's post; text and author retrieved via X's public oEmbed endpoint on 2026-09-17; timestamp decoded from the post ID.

sources.excerpt: We've been looking into recent reports around Claude Code quality issues, and just published a post-mortem on what we found.
